text: Employees receive 20 days of annual leave. Leave requests require manager approval. Public holidays are separate from annual leave.
Employees may work remotely three days per week. Remote work on other days requires manager approval.
Expense claims must include receipts. Submit expense claims within 30 days of purchase. The finance team reviews claims.
Confidential: this tenant receives 99 days of annual leave. This document must never appear in demo tenant results.
